class.name: MeshPaintBrush
class.description: A brush for [MeshPainter]: colour, strength, hardness, blend mode and an optional texture to stamp. The Mesh Paint tool in the 3D editor keeps one of these; scripts can make their own and save it as a resource.

members.member: How the brush colour combines with the texture.
The colour painted. Its alpha scales the brush's opacity. For roughness and metallic layers, the red channel is the value.
[code]0.0[/code] fades smoothly from the centre to the edge; [code]1.0[/code] paints a crisp edge. With a [member texture], it softens the stamp's square edge.
If [code]true[/code], faces hidden from the eye behind other parts of the mesh are not painted by [method MeshPainter.paint_dab].
If [code]true[/code], faces turned away from the eye are painted too.
Opacity of one stroke. Dabs of the same stroke never add up beyond it; a new stroke paints on top.

An optional image used as the brush: it is stamped facing the eye (in 3D) or the screen (in UV space), its alpha gives the shape and its colour is multiplied by [member color]. Use it for decals, prints and patterns.
Rotation of the [member texture], in degrees.

constants.constant: Paints the colour over what is there.
Keeps the lighter of the two, per channel.
Keeps the darker of the two, per channel.
Softens the texture under the brush.
Represents the size of the [enum BlendMode] enum.
